name: gizza-ai/image-document-shadow-remove
summary: Remove shadows and uneven lighting from a document photo

tool.description: Remove cast shadows and uneven lighting from a phone photo or scan of a document, flattening it to a clean near-white page while keeping the text and ink sharp. mode 'color' preserves coloured ink/highlights (default), 'grayscale' gives a neutral gray page, 'blackwhite' produces a crisp 1-bit black-and-white scan (Otsu threshold). whiteness (0-100, default 55) sets how hard the paper background is snapped to pure white. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

mode.description: Output treatment: color (keep coloured ink, default), grayscale (neutral gray), or blackwhite (crisp 1-bit scan).

whiteness.description: How hard to whiten the page background, 0-100 (higher snaps near-white paper to pure white; default 55).
